home.aboutDesc: THE BLUE POINT is a free-of-cost, connected family care and assistance platform. We help families coordinate daily well-being, healthcare access, safety, and practical help, especially when family members live in different places. Our goal is 'From Digital Reminders to Real-World Assistance'.
